name: Build the First System
description: Decide the room, the channel count and the budget split before buying any box. Ends with a system you can measure and upgrade.

name: Home Theater, Room by Room
description: From a 5.1.2 living-room layout to height channels, dialogue and bass that holds up across more than one seat.

name: Two-Channel Hi-Fi
description: Source, amplification, loudspeakers and seat geometry treated as a single chain, with the failure case recorded.

name: Room and Bass Tuning
description: Learn to read an in-room sweep, move the seat and the subwoofer, then calibrate in an order that can be repeated.
